# Retired Wrap-It-Up Boundary

Closeout is owned by the supported CStar closeout surface. The historical
autonomous wrapper and loop grant no test-repair, state-write, or Git authority.

```gherkin
Feature: Retired wrap-up boundary
  Scenario: A caller invokes a historical wrap-up or sovereign-loop entrypoint
    Given no legacy wrap-up activity is authorized
    When the compatibility entrypoint is invoked
    Then it raises "legacy_wrap_it_up_retired_use_cstar_closeout"
    And no source, state, documentation, process, network, provider, callback, or Git activity starts
```
